## Learning objectives

::: callout-note
### Learning objectives

**At the end of this lesson you will:**

-  Be familiar with linear regression as a type of regression methods used for prediction in supervised learning 
-  Recognize cross-validation techniques
-  Use `tidymodels` as collection of packages for modeling and machine learning using `tidyverse` principles

:::
